title: Professor Huyang
description: An ancient Droid with knowledge of Jedi Lightsabers going back centuries in his databanks, Professor Huyang trained generations of younglings in the construction and operation of their Lightsabers. He survived the end of the Jedi Order and their purge. He also assisted Ahsoka Tano in her training of Sabine Wren and adventured across the galaxy to stop Grand Admiral Thrawn.
